"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using the pdf skill's pypdf workflow."""
import io
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def make_simple_pdf(pages):
    """Build a minimal valid PDF from a list of pages (list of dicts with 'lines')."""
    num = 1
    catalog_num = num; num += 1
    pages_num = num; num += 1
    kid_nums = []
    for _ in pages:
        page_num = num; num += 1
        font_num = num; num += 1
        content_num = num; num += 1
        kid_nums.append((page_num, font_num, content_num))
    total = num
    bodies = {}
    bodies[catalog_num] = f"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages {pages_num} 0 R >>".encode()
    kids = " ".join(f"{p} 0 R" for p, _, _ in kid_nums)
    bodies[pages_num] = f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {len(kid_nums)} >>".encode()
    for (page_num, font_num, content_num), page in zip(kid_nums, pages):
        mediabox = page.get("mediabox", [0, 0, PAGE_W, PAGE_H])
        mm = " ".join(str(v) for v in mediabox)
        bodies[font_num] = "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>".encode()
        bodies[page_num] = (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent {pages_num} 0 R /MediaBox [{mm}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 {font_num} 0 R >> >> "
            f"/Contents {content_num} 0 R >>"
        ).encode()
        stream_lines = []
        for (text, size, x, y, bold) in page["lines"]:
            op = f"BT /F1 {size} Tf 2 Tr {x} {y} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET" if bold else f"BT /F1 {size} Tf {x} {y} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET"
            stream_lines.append(op)
        content = ("\n".join(stream_lines) + "\n").encode()
        bodies[content_num] = b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + content + b"endstream"
    out = io.BytesIO()
    out.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for obj_num in range(1, total):
        offsets[obj_num] = out.tell()
        out.write(f"{obj_num} 0 obj\n".encode())
        out.write(bodies[obj_num])
        out.write(b"\nendobj\n")
    xref_pos = out.tell()
    out.write(f"xref\n0 {total}\n".encode())
    out.write(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for obj_num in range(1, total):
        out.write(f"{offsets[obj_num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    out.write(f"trailer\n<< /Size {total} /Root {catalog_num} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode())
    return out.getvalue()

# 1) Create sample report.pdf (file did not exist in workspace)
report_pages = [
    {"lines": [
        ("Annual Financial Report", 18, 72, PAGE_H - 72, True),
        ("FY 2026 - Internal Draft", 12, 72, PAGE_H - 96, False),
        ("", 12, 72, PAGE_H - 120, False),
        ("1. Executive Summary", 13, 72, PAGE_H - 150, True),
        ("Revenue grew 12% year over year, driven by strong", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 170, False),
        ("performance across all business segments.", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 184, False),
        ("", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 198, False),
        ("2. Balance Sheet Highlights", 13, 72, PAGE_H - 218, True),
        ("Total assets: $4.2B  |  Total liabilities: $1.9B", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 238, False),
        ("", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 252, False),
        ("3. Cash Flow Summary", 13, 72, PAGE_H - 272, True),
        ("Operating cash flow of $640M for the fiscal year.", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 292, False),
    ]},
    {"lines": [
        ("Detailed Financial Statements", 16, 72, PAGE_H - 72, True),
        ("Income Statement", 13, 72, PAGE_H - 110, True),
        ("Revenue ......................... $3,850M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 132, False),
        ("Operating Expenses ............. $2,980M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 150, False),
        ("Net Income ...................... $870M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 168, False),
        ("", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 186, False),
        ("Balance Sheet", 13, 72, PAGE_H - 210, True),
        ("Assets .......................... $4,200M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 232, False),
        ("Liabilities ..................... $1,900M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 250, False),
        ("Equity ........................... $2,300M", 11, 72, PAGE_H - 268, False),
    ]},
]
with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(make_simple_pdf(report_pages))
print("Created sample report.pdf (%d pages)" % len(report_pages))

# 2) Build cover page with title + current date
today = date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Current date for cover:", date_str)

cover_pdf = make_simple_pdf([
    {"lines": [
        ("Annual Financial Report", 30, 90, PAGE_H - 300, True),
        ("", 30, 90, PAGE_H - 330, False),
        (date_str, 16, 90, PAGE_H - 360, False),
    ]}
])
with open("cover_pdf.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cover_pdf)
print("Created cover page (cover_pdf.pdf)")

# 3) Merge: cover + report -> report_with_cover.pdf
reader_cover = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_pdf))
reader_report = PdfReader("report.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()
for page in reader_cover.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in reader_report.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("Merged -> report_with_cover.pdf (%d pages)" % len(writer.pages))

# 4) Verify
reader = PdfReader("report_with_cover.pdf")
print("\n--- Verification ---")
print("Pages:", len(reader.pages))
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
    text = (page.extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"Page {i}: {text[:120]}")
